title: Selling Plans — Fee Credits on Orders the Seller Cancelled Before Shipment
content:
## Policy

On **Selling Plans**, an order the seller cancelled after its payment was captured and before it shipped, recorded as a seller cancellation defect on the seller's standing record, earns a cancellation credit on the variable final value fee record of that order, booked with the order cancellation credit reason.

| Element | What the policy fixes |
|---|---|
| Order that earns the credit | One the seller cancelled after payment capture and before shipment |
| Record that shows it | A seller cancellation defect on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record |
| Fee record credited | The variable final value fee record of that order |
| Credit reason recorded | Order cancellation |
| Observable effect | The cancellation credit is listed against that order's fee, dated the day it is booked; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given |

## Booking tool: `book_cancellation_fee_credit_79bf63bc`

**Capability.** Books one seller fee credit, with the credit reason given, against the variable final value fee record of an order the seller cancelled while it was unshipped. The record carries the credit before any administration fee, the administration fee withheld and the credit actually given; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_cancellation_fee_credit_79bf63bc` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fee_event_ref` | The fee reference number of the cancelled order's variable final value fee record being credited, as shown in the seller fee lookup | Id |
| `credit_reason` | Why the credit is given | Exactly one of `order_refund` (money taken back from the seller for the order, by a seller-funded refund or by a chargeback), `order_cancellation` (an order the seller cancelled while it was unshipped), `fee_dispute_upheld` (a seller fee dispute decided in the seller's favour) |
| `gross_credit_amount` | The credit before the administration fee | USD, a non-negative amount to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `refund_admin_fee_amount` | The administration fee withheld from the credit | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 when none |
| `credit_amount` | The credit actually given to the seller | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `credit_id` (the fee reference of the new credit record), `fee_event_ref` (the credited fee record), `order_id` (the order of that fee record), `credit_reason` (the reason recorded), `gross_credit_amount`, `refund_admin_fee_amount` and `credit_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date). A receipt carrying a `credit_id` means the credit is booked.

## Contract Q&A

**Does the tool decide whether the order qualifies?** No. It books the credit with the values it is given; it judges no eligibility and computes no amount.
